u0: The episode has just begun and the agent has not yet seen the matching key. Progress: no key located. Next objective: explore the corridor and the left‑column rooms to bring the matching key into view, at which point key_found latches and the machine advances to u1.
u1: The matching key has been located (key_found is latched) but the agent is not yet carrying it. Progress: the key's position is known. Next objective: move to the key and pick it up with empty hands to gain has_matching_key and advance to u2.
u2: The agent is carrying the matching key. Progress: key in hand, locked door still closed. Next objective: navigate to the locked door in the target room's left wall and toggle it open, giving target_door_open and advancing to u3. Note the key must later be dropped before the ball can be picked up.
u3: The locked target door is open and the agent still holds the matching key. Progress: access to the target room is available. Next objective: drop the key (so hands are free) and step onto the doorway or into the target room to enter it, giving target_room_entered and advancing to u4.
u4: The agent has entered the target room (doorway counts as inside) and the door is open. Progress: the ball is reachable but not yet held. Next objective: locate the mission's ball and pick it up with empty hands to set target_picked_up and advance to u5.
u5: Terminal successful state: the agent is carrying the mission's designated ball, the episode ends here. Progress: all milestones met (key located, key held, door opened, room entered, ball picked up). No further objective; the task is complete.
